messages:
Rina: Quick flag — onboarding 'cobalt-lite-13b' (llama->gemma) shows token-glue and per-head rotary phase drift after GPTQ q4_0. Minimal repro below.

Rina: Repro (short):
```bash
python convert.py --src ckpt/cobalt --dst cobalt-lite --out cobalt.pt
python quantize.py --model cobalt.pt --scheme q4_0 --out cobalt.q4
python quick_run.py --model cobalt.q4 --prompt \"The capital of Italy is\" --max-tokens 6 --dump-logits
```
Observed: occasional glued tokens ("RomeItaly") and duplicate EOS on some runs.

Jon: Paste token ids + rotary shapes pre/post quant and a short logits diff.

Rina: Snippet:
``nids: [45, 102, 7, 2]
tokens: ["The", "capital", "of", "</s>"]
q4_out_tokens: ["The", "capitalof", "</s>"]
rotary_shape_pre: [32,64]
rotary_meta_post: [2048]  # flattened by packer
logit_diff_mean: 0.012
```

Priya: That flattened shape explains per-head phase mismatch — converter/packer collapsed (heads,head_dim) into 1D. Also run tokenizer-scan: we've seen NFC vs NFKC normalization cause merged byte-seqs and glue.

Sam: Triage: added runtime fallback to rebuild per-head inv_freq when rotary tensor is 1D. Pseudo: `if rotary.ndim==1: rebuild = inv_freq.reshape(1,head_dim).repeat(num_heads,1)` — fixes short prompts locally, perf +1.5ms/token.

Rina: eval-bot: lexicon-smoke for cobalt.q4 -> 5/432 failing (diacritics & tokenization). Report: https://internal/reports/1777777777

Jon: Next actions: (1) Rina open WIP PR with runtime fallback + test; (2) Priya add tokenizer normalization check and duplicate byte-seq guard in converter; (3) Sam run q3_k small shard to see if quant grouping preserves shape. If q3_k preserves, prefer it temporarily.

Priya: Will add NFC normalization and a converter assert comparing rotary shape metadata pre/post-pack. If mismatch, fail conversion with remediation steps.

Rina: Opening PR now and tagging owners. Will post q3_k numbers when ready. :coffee:
